answer: Examine the clock, not the claim. A crystal repeats its lattice flawlessly; dawn light scatters. Measure every account's entropy: reply gaps, topic drift, sleep hours. Ten thousand human lives scatter across a whole zenith of timestamps; one operator driving ten thousand clones leaks a heartbeat - a telltale periodic pulse across the fleet. A farm must then buy genuine messiness per key, and a human pulse is the only input sold singly, at retail.
